pwaUpdate.title: New version available
pwaUpdate.message: A new version of RaidOps is available. If you don't reload now, some features may stop working correctly until you reload the page.

raidGrouping.title: Grouping ping, from the site or Discord
raidGrouping.description: On a published raid's page, the "Ping to group up" button (Officer only) posts a one-off message in the announcement channel, mentioning every assigned player and stating which character to whisper for an invite, with a snapshot of the composition attached as an embed. The same action is available from Discord via the /raid invite command, with autocomplete raid selection and an optional character.

raidCompositionAnnouncement.title: A standing Discord announcement of a raid's composition
raidCompositionAnnouncement.description: A new "Raid composition announcement" setting (Notifications tab) posts an embed listing every slot of a published raid, group by group — that same message is edited in place on every assignment, unassignment, swap, or spec change, never reposted. A separate DM setting also notifies each player added or removed, with their character and a link to the raid.

guildSettingsReorg.title: Guild settings reorganized into 4 tabs, with autosave
guildSettingsReorg.description: The old "Branches" tab is now split into three: General (branch activation, region, timezone, language), Roster (per-branch roster access mode and Officer roles), and Raids (a new "Raid mode" setting, not yet functional — groundwork for a future explicit sign-up feature). Every field across all 4 tabs now saves automatically, no Save button.

pwaInstall.title: RaidOps can now be installed as an app, and updates itself automatically
pwaInstall.description: You can now install RaidOps from your browser (Chrome/Edge) to open it in its own window, like a real app. Whether installed or not, it automatically checks for new versions every time you open it, downloads them in the background without interrupting your work, then offers to reload so you can use them.

liveRoleRefresh.title: Role, permission, and guild access changes now apply live, no more waiting
liveRoleRefresh.description: When an officer updated your Discord roles, or you joined/left a guild's Discord server, RaidOps used to wait until your session token expired (up to 15 minutes) before picking it up. Your session is now notified instantly and refreshes your profile in the background, so updated permissions and guild access apply right away.

changelogRework.title: Changelog reorganized by theme and synced across devices
changelogRework.description: The What's New page now groups entries into categories (themselves grouped under broader eras), with a Feature / Improvement / Fix distinction. Your read status is now tied to your account instead of your browser, so what you've seen stays seen even on a different device.

raidNotifications.title: Discord notifications for raid changes and composition edits
raidNotifications.description: Two new notification settings: "Raid changes" posts when a raid is published, cancelled, or rescheduled, and "Raid composition changes" posts whenever an already-published raid's roster is edited (assign, unassign, swap, spec change) — draft-stage tinkering stays silent. The guild audit log also now tracks every one of these actions.

raidBuilder.title: Compose raid groups by drag & drop
raidBuilder.description: A new Raids page lets officers build raid compositions by dragging characters from a live roster pool onto a group/slot grid — swap two assigned characters, or click an empty slot to search and assign one instead. Set up a recurring series so a weekly raid and its target zones don't need recreating by hand every time. A raid stays a draft, invisible to regular roster members, until an officer publishes it.

branchNotifications.title: Per-branch Discord notification overrides
branchNotifications.description: Notification settings (starting with absences) can now be overridden for a specific branch instead of only guild-wide, with a clear "inherited from the guild-wide setting" indicator and one-click revert. Missing bot permissions are now listed by name (e.g. "send messages", "embed links") instead of a generic warning.

globalCalendar.title: Your availability calendar now follows you, not just one guild
globalCalendar.description: Absences and recurring patterns are global by default — no more redeclaring the same absence for every guild. Optionally scope a declaration to one specific branch when it only applies there. Find it under My account → Calendar.

guildBranches.title: Manage several WoW versions in the same guild
guildBranches.description: A Discord guild can now activate several WoW branches in parallel (e.g. Classic Anniversary and MoP Classic), each with its own roster access mode and its own Officer roles. Once a guild has more than one active branch, tabs appear on the roster to switch between them.

guildNotifications.title: Discord notifications for guild events
guildNotifications.description: Configure, per event (starting with declared absences), whether the bot posts a message to a Discord channel — and which one — from the new Notifications tab in guild settings.

calendar.title: A calendar to declare your absences and recurring patterns
calendar.description: Declare one-off absences/lateness (single date or range, reason, partial time bounds) or a recurring pattern (weekly, or a 5x8-style shift rotation) — changes are never retroactive on days that have already passed.

bnetMultiAccount.title: Link multiple Battle.net accounts
bnetMultiAccount.description: A single RaidOps account can now link several Battle.net accounts and import characters from each — handy if you play on more than one Blizzard account.

uiRefresh.title: A more consistent look, and the app now works on mobile/tablet
uiRefresh.description: New interface components (buttons, checkboxes, menus, tables…) with a more uniform look. Dense screens like the roster or audit log now adapt to small screens by switching to a card view.

whatsNew.title: A What's new page to track updates
whatsNew.description: The 📣 icon in the header lists the features added to RaidOps over time, with a badge when there's something new to see.

manual.title: An in-app help manual
manual.description: Every page now has a "?" pointing to a step-by-step guide: Discord sign-in, character import, guild management (roster, settings, audit log), and more.

getStarted.description: A 4-step wizard (Discord, guild, Battle.net, roster) guides newcomers end to end, picking up exactly where they left off.

auditLog.title: Guild audit log
auditLog.description: Full history of notable guild actions (settings, joins/leaves, rank changes), filterable and sortable by column.
